summary: Fidelis Insurance Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing it repurchased all remaining common shares owned by CVC Falcon Holdings Limited in a share repurchase announced March 2, 2026, leaving CVC with no ownership. No price or value was stated. In connection, CVC irrevocably waived all governance, information, director-nomination and registration rights under the shareholders agreement, bye-laws and registration rights agreement. Director Daniel Brand resigned from the board and all committees. The filing was used to incorporate the disclosure into Fidelis' registration statements. This is a capital return event where the issuer bought out a major concentrated holder.
